title: Unit 0 · Everyday English
instructions: Complete each answer in English. Use full words and check spelling before submitting.

sections.title: 1 · School and getting around
sections.instructions: Complete each sentence with the missing word or phrase.

questions.prompt: I walk to school. I go to school ___. (on foot)
We took a ___ to the airport. (taksówka)
We eat lunch in the school ___.
Our teacher prints worksheets in the ___.
We use computers in the ___.
We learn about the past in ___ lessons.
For ___, wear trainers and comfortable clothes. (PE)

sections.title: 2 · Food and containers
sections.instructions: Write the best word or phrase for each clue.

questions.prompt: A small amount cut from a larger chocolate bar: a ___ of chocolate.
Jam is usually kept in a ___.
Water and juice are often sold in a ___.
A metal container for a fizzy drink is a ___.
A thin piece cut from a loaf of bread is a ___ of bread.
A small amount of salt used in cooking is a ___ of salt.
You pack books for moving house in a ___.

sections.title: 3 · Jobs and places
sections.instructions: Complete the sentences with a job or a place of work.

questions.prompt: A receptionist welcomes guests and works in a ___.
A doctor usually works in a ___.
A teacher works at a ___.
A ___ flies a plane. (job)
A ___ prepares food in a restaurant. (job)
Police officers work at a police ___.
A farmer grows crops and looks after animals on a ___.

sections.title: 4 · Present simple and adjective + preposition
sections.instructions: Use the correct present simple form or complete the collocation.

questions.prompt: ___ she ___ in a big city? (live)
I ___ my smart clothes very often. (not wear)
Our dog usually ___ for us by the door. (wait)
___ you ___ the plants every day? (water)
I'm ___ ___ getting lost in a big city. (afraid)
She's ___ ___ tomorrow's test.
We're ___ ___ our school trip.
He is ___ ___ playing football.
